summary: Iteration 20 — Invite Staff feature. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests passing (admin RBAC on /api/invites POST/GET/DELETE, public GET/POST accept, single-use enforcement, password length validation, role=admin rejection, existing-email rejection, non-admin 403). Frontend: full UI flow verified — Settings page loads (gear icon in sidebar), Invite Staff modal shows email/role (no admin option)/tab checklist (including claims + audit), creating invite reveals copyable link, invite appears in Invitations table. Accept-invite page in fresh context shows clinic + role, form accepts name+password, redirects to dashboard with token set, reusing token shows invite-invalid, bogus token shows invite-invalid, doctor login cannot access /settings (no-access shown, no sidebar link).
critical_code_review_comments: AcceptInvite modal shows role badge but not the invited email prominently — the email is present in a small stone-500 span, admins/testers may miss it. Minor UX nit.
Invite creation on Team.js does not clear the Invitations empty-state cache locally on the fly; refresh via loadInvites is triggered which is fine.
invites collection lacks compound index; consider unique index on email+status='pending' to prevent duplicate pending invites (currently allowed).
seed_data_creation: Test invites/users were created during pytest + UI test and cleaned up post-run via admin API. No lingering TEST_ data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Invite lifecycle fully covered. If extending: consider negative tests for duplicate pending invite for same email, invite created for role='admin' path (already covered — 400), and expiry (currently NO expiry by design).
